changelog:
## 1.1.1

- Reset DESFire selection and authentication when the reader field turns off
  or the ISO-DEP session ends. Each new activation starts at PICC level.

## 1.1

- Add the EV3 build profile with EV1 and EV2 commands, up to four
  applications, 16 files, and 3 KiB of file data.
- Keep human-readable .dfc credentials. Load the text codec only when
  importing or saving; compiled .dfcb credentials remain supported.
- Correct ATQA and ISO-DEP framing for PC/SC readers, including ACR1552.
- Reduce RAM use by allocating transaction snapshots and incoming command
  chains only when needed.
- Add host credential compilation and protocol and memory probes. Update to
  dfc-core 1.2.0 and the consolidated tiny-crypto-c backend.
description:
# DFC

Read and emulate generic MIFARE DESFire-compatible NFC credentials on Flipper Zero.

## Features

- Legacy DES, ISO 3DES, and AES authentication
- Standard, backup, value, and record files
- Human-readable .dfc and compiled .dfcb credentials
- Writable blank-card credentials that can be saved after emulation

## Credentials

Place saved credentials in SD Card/apps_data/dfc/. DFC uses the all-zero
factory DES key at the PICC level when no saved credential is selected.

## Disclaimer

DFC is an independent, third-party implementation of the MIFARE DESFire
native command protocol. It is not developed, authorized, licensed, or
endorsed by NXP Semiconductors. "DESFire" is used here solely to describe
protocol compatibility, not to claim affiliation.

MIFARE and DESFire are trademarks of NXP B.V.
